question: What refuge for one who would cling to the all-favoring position?
premises: If you would cling to the all-favoring position.
Then resort to the supreme-nondual view, the great refuge.
inference: The all-favoring position resolves into the supreme-nondual refuge.
plain_english: If you would cling to the all-favoring position, then resort to the supreme-nondual view — the great refuge.
